description: This file declares the ServerControllerImpl class, which implements the IController interface for IPC server control in the Rialto project. It provides server-side methods for managing RPC call failures, cancellation, and retrieving the client that made the request.

classes.name: ServerControllerImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing the IController interface, managing RPC server control functionalities such as failure handling, cancellation, and client retrieval.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Returns false indicating the server controller has not failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns an empty string as error text.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Starts cancellation of the RPC call (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure reason for the RPC call.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC call has been canceled.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC call is canceled.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the client that made the RPC request.
